transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, we have 480 precision castings from Cell 7 on quality hold after yesterday's abnormal cooling event. Visual inspection came back clean with no visible cracks, but the castings haven't been released to machining yet. Before I make a final disposition, I need to complete our standard pre-disposition review. I'd like to hear from metrology, maintenance, and production control so we can make an informed decision together. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, I can start on the metrology side. I completed a dimensional review of all 480 castings this morning. 312 of them meet the flatness limit of 0.30 mm or less, but 168 measure above 0.30 mm and will need to be reworked before they can be released. The full measurement report is finished but it's still in the metrology report queue and hasn't reached you yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: On the maintenance side, my inspection found that the Cell 7 cooling-fan belt is damaged and must be replaced before another production run. I confirmed with the maintenance technician this morning that the replacement takes exactly 2 hours. The work order hasn't been entered yet, but the repair can be done during the planned production pause.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: On the production control side, I checked the machining schedule and confirmed that the 312 conforming castings can start machining at exactly Thursday 14:00. The 168 nonconforming castings must remain out of that machining slot. I received the scheduler's confirmation today, but I have not yet updated the production plan.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Release the 312 conforming castings to machining with a start time of Thursday 14:00.
The 168 nonconforming castings measuring above 0.30 mm flatness must remain on hold for rework before any release.
Replace the Cell 7 cooling-fan belt during the planned production pause; the repair takes 2 hours.
Ensure the completed dimensional measurement report is delivered from the metrology report queue to finalize records.
Update the production plan to reflect the Thursday 14:00 machining start for the 312 conforming castings and the exclusion of the 168 nonconforming castings from that slot.
